# GroupToStay

> B2B marketplace where verified group organizers submit one Group Request and receive competing quotations from approved hotels — built for Umrah, Hajj, tourism, corporate, sports and event groups.

GroupToStay connects agencies, corporate travel teams, and event organizers with vetted hotels for group accommodation sourcing. Organizers post a single Group Request; matched hotels return quotations that can be compared side by side before awarding the booking.

- [Home](/): Overview of the GroupToStay marketplace and how to post a Group Request.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): Three-step flow from Group Request to confirmed booking.

- [Pricing](/pricing): Free access for organizers; plans and commission structure for hotels.
